mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in GDP growth rate indicates a robust economy, leading to higher consumer spending and subsequently driving up the S&P 500 index over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong GDP growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 5%, it signals a tightening monetary cycle, leading to decreased borrowing and spending, and ultimately resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is above 5%, despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate indicates a weakening labor market, leading to decreased consumer spending and subsequently driving down the S&P 500 index over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in periods of rising unemployment are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production indicates a strong supply chain, leading to increased economic growth and subsequently driving up the S&P 500 index over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong industrial production growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts increase and GDP growth rate is strong, it signals a robust economy, leading to higher consumer spending and subsequently driving up the S&P 500 index over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong housing starts and GDP growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is below 4% and the CPI is increasing, it signals an inflationary environment, leading to decreased purchasing power and subsequently driving down the S&P 500 index over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 4% and CPIAUCSL is above 3%, despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in payroll employment indicates a strong labor market, leading to increased consumer spending and subsequently driving up the S&P 500 index over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in periods of rising payroll employment are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales increase and housing starts are strong, it signals a robust economy, leading to higher consumer spending and subsequently driving up the S&P 500 index over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong retail sales and housing starts (t-test p > 0.05).
